target.title: ci: add GitHub Pages deploy workflow for website
target.body:
## Summary

- Publishes the `website/` app through GitHub Pages at the canonical public URL, `https://voxcli.sh`.
- Uses one Pages workflow with current action majors, read-only Pages metadata access in the build job, deployment-only Pages/OIDC write permissions, and manual recovery dispatch.
- Builds from the Pages-configured base path, so custom-domain `/` and repository fallback `/vox/` assets both resolve correctly.
- Fixes the preloader, favicon, canonical URL, and social-image paths; verifies the generated HTML, JavaScript assets, and CNAME artifact.
- Removes the unused Netlify and Vercel deployment configurations so GitHub Pages is the single hosting contract.

## User impact

The Vox marketing site now has an owned deployment path and canonical public URL. Changes under `website/` publish automatically after the deployment build, typecheck, and artifact checks pass.

## Hosting contract

- Canonical URL: `https://voxcli.sh`
- Publisher: GitHub Pages, using GitHub Actions
- Domain artifact: `website/public/CNAME`
- Base path: supplied by `actions/configure-pages`, not hardcoded
- Build permissions: `contents: read` and `pages: read`
- Deploy permissions: `pages: write` and `id-token: write`

## Proof

- Exact PR head: `55ff48e8b4ac1a58dfde74f655d5549374c8723d`
- Merge commit: `3636523cb21d5ec85dcb378785c6e26191bb15e3`
- Root: frozen install, format/lint, typecheck, 61/61 tests, and production build pass.
- Website: frozen install and typecheck pass.
- Production builds and deploy verification pass for both `/` and `/vox/`.
- `actionlint` passes for CI and deploy workflows.
- Exact-head [PR CI](https://github.com/steipete/vox/actions/runs/28517788965) passes on Node 22, Node 24, website verification, and GitGuardian.
- Post-merge [CI](https://github.com/steipete/vox/actions/runs/28573257161) passes at the merge commit.
- [GitHub Pages deployment](https://github.com/steipete/vox/actions/runs/28573257540) builds, verifies, uploads, and deploys successfully at the merge commit.
- Namecheap DNS uses GitHub's four apex A records, four apex AAAA records, and `www` CNAME `steipete.github.io`; authoritative DNS and 1.1.1.1 return the same records.
- GitHub Pages reports the custom domain valid and served by Pages; the approved certificate covers `voxcli.sh` and `www.voxcli.sh`, and HTTPS enforcement is enabled.
- `https://voxcli.sh/` and its JavaScript/logo assets return 200; `https://www.voxcli.sh/` redirects to the apex.
- Existing-Chrome proof renders the full production landing page at `https://voxcli.sh/` with the expected title, navigation, hero, and product visualization.
- Structured Codex autoreview raised one Pages-permission concern. It was rejected from the action contract and production proof: `configure-pages@v6` needs write only for optional enablement, while this metadata-only build step succeeds with `pages: read`; deployment write/OIDC remain isolated to the deploy job.

## Production state

GitHub Pages is the sole hosting contract. DNS, build, deployment, canonical metadata, asset paths, certificate coverage, HTTPS enforcement, and rendered production behavior are proven.
